name: saga-a2ui-examples
description: Example apps built with saga a2ui — interactive experiences inside AI assistants and agents, with source code and connection instructions.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:view && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && npm run typecheck -w saga-tic-tac-toe-example
scripts.build: npm run build:view && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist -c apps/tic-tac-toe/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.check: node scripts/check-brand.mjs && node scripts/check-icons.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm run test:game && vitest run && npm run test:browser && npm run build
scripts.test:game: npm run build:local && vitest run --config vitest.game.config.ts
